description: For office supply, this checklist records operational need, standard-item match, substitution, delivery date, unit cost, order minimum, and storage capacity. Its supporting evidence includes stock count, catalog reference, price comparison, prior usage, approval, receipt, and discrepancy documentation.

title: Office Supply Checklist
use_case: Use the checklist during office supply replenishment and control when the office supply record must identify requester, worksite, supply category, item, quantity, current stock, preferred supplier, and accounting code. Complete the applicable handoff for order reference, received quantity, storage location, backorder status, requester notification, and inventory adjustment.
